# MR Vehicle Rental (Manoranjan Travels)

> Premium Vehicle Rental, Wedding Transportation, Self-Drive & Corporate Fleet Provider in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Overview
- **Name:** MR Vehicle Rental / Manoranjan Vehicle Rental (Registered under Office of Company Registrar, Tourism Office Kathmandu, Nepal Travel Vehicle Association)
- **Headquarters:** Kalopul, Kathmandu, Nepal (Geo: 27.7118° N, 85.3353° E, Postal Code: 44600)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +977-9702134274
- **Email:** manoranjantravels2024@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://manoranjan.com.np
- **Operating Hours:** 24/7 Available (365 days)
- **Fleet Ownership:** 100% company-owned fleet (No third-party outsourcing)

## Services Offered
- **Rent with Driver (Chauffeur Service):** Chauffeur-driven sedans, SUVs, 4WD Jeeps, Hiace tourist vans, Coaster minibuses, and luxury buses for city sightseeing, airport pickups, and inter-city routes across Nepal.
- **Wedding Vehicle Rental in Kathmandu:** Complete wedding transportation fleets including decorated Bridal & Groom sedans/luxury SUVs (Prado, Fortuner, Land Cruiser), family SUVs, Toyota Hiace vans (14–16 seaters), Nissan/Toyota Coaster minibuses (22–28 seaters), and Deluxe Tourist Buses (35–40 seaters) for Janti processions, Swayamvar, reception transfers, and destination weddings (Dhulikhel, Nagarkot, Pokhara, Chitwan, Sauraha). Non-damaging floral ribbon/suction decorations permitted.
- **Self-Drive Car Rental:** Driverless rental options for cars and SUVs across Nepal starting from 30 days minimum with flexible monthly, quarterly, and annual lease packages. Fixed pickup location at Kalopul, Kathmandu.
- **Corporate Fleet Rental & B2B Leasing:** Long-term corporate vehicle leasing for enterprises, embassies, and NGOs with VAT-compliant invoicing, SLA uptime guarantee, and 60-minute replacement support.
- **Airport Transfers:** 24/7 private transfers to/from Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) to Thamel, Patan, Bhaktapur, and Nagarkot.

- **Sedan / Hatchback (4 Seater):** NPR 5,000 / $37 (Swift Dzire, Hyundai Aura, Honda City) - Bridal Cars, City Tours & Airport Transfers — https://manoranjan.com.np/vehicles/car-rent
- **Comfort & Premium SUV (4-7 Seater):** NPR 6,000 - 8,000 / $44 - $59 (Toyota Fortuner, Prado, Land Cruiser, Suzuki Brezza, BYD Atto 3 EV) - VIP Wedding Entry, Highway & Family Trips — https://manoranjan.com.np/vehicles/suv-rent
- **4WD Rugged Jeep (7 Seater):** NPR 7,000 / $52 (Mahindra Scorpio 4x4) - Upper Mustang, Manang, Muktinath, Rara off-road — https://manoranjan.com.np/vehicles/jeep-rent
- **Toyota Hiace / Jumbo Hiace Tourist Van (10-16 Seater):** NPR 8,000 / $59 - Close Family Wedding Groups, Pilgrimage & Trekking Transfers — https://manoranjan.com.np/vehicles/hiace-rent
- **Nissan / Toyota Coaster Mini Bus (18-28 Seater):** NPR 11,000 / $81 - Medium Janti Groups, Corporate Retreats & Resort Weddings — https://manoranjan.com.np/vehicles/minibus-rent

## Key Destinations & Service Areas Covered
- Kathmandu Valley (Kathmandu, Lalitpur/Patan, Bhaktapur, Kalopul, Thamel, Boudha, Budhanilkantha, Godawari)
- Hill Resort & Destination Wedding Hubs (Dhulikhel, Nagarkot, Chandragiri, Kakani, Daman)
- Pokhara (Prithvi Highway corridor, Sarangkot, Begnas)
- Chitwan National Park & Sauraha (Destination weddings & wildlife safaris)
- Lumbini, Bandipur, Gorkha, Janakpur, Mustang, Manang, Rara Lake, and Langtang
